column2: I... truth be told, I was damn scared...
it feels like a feeling I'd forgotten is coming back...
No matter how much you come to hate me...
When I saw you $$大ケガ$$, I felt like my chest was being crushed.
I wouldn't know... what the hell to do...
If you're by my side, I don't need anything else...
I... for you, I can do anything!
Even if it means being judged for any $$罪$$...
